name: The Builder's Path
description: Do you know what this engine can do? Each step is a system most worlds never touch. Ship one of each and you will have learned the engine and produced content doing it.

steps.label: Build a room
steps.hint: `redit create <title>`, or `dig <dir> <title>` to attach it as you go.

steps.label: Something worth examining
steps.hint: `redit extradesc add <keywords>` rewards the players who look.

steps.label: A room that changes with the season
steps.hint: `redit spring|summer|autumn|winter` — the season system exists and almost nothing uses it.

steps.label: A door
steps.hint: `redit door <dir> <name>`, and give it a key with `redit key <dir> <vnum>`.

steps.label: A room you can do something in
steps.hint: `redit verb add pull` declares it; a DG OnCommand trigger makes it do something.

steps.label: Build a mobile
steps.hint: `medit create <name>`. Put every noun in its short description into its keywords.

steps.label: An NPC who answers a keyword
An NPC with a real conversation
steps.hint: Branching dialogue with conditions and effects. The deepest thing the NPC system does — see docs/builder/dialogue-trees.md.

steps.label: An NPC with somewhere to be
steps.hint: `medit <vnum> routine add <hour> <room> <activity>` — a world where people keep hours feels alive.

steps.label: A shop that sells something
steps.hint: Set the shopkeeper flag, then `medit <vnum> shop stock add <item vnum>`.

steps.label: An NPC who belongs to something
steps.hint: `medit <vnum> faction <tag>` — reputation, aggro and shop pricing all read it.

steps.label: An NPC killing carries moral weight
steps.hint: `medit <vnum> alignment <-200..200>`. Zero means nobody thought about it.

steps.label: Build an item
steps.hint: `oedit create <name>`, then set a real type.

steps.label: An item that does something when worn
steps.hint: `oedit <vnum> affect add <stat> <amount>` — affects become buffs on equip.

steps.label: Write a quest
steps.hint: `quedit create <vnum> <name>`, add objectives and rewards, hang it on a giver.

steps.label: A quest with more than one step
steps.hint: Two objectives make a story; one makes an errand.

steps.label: Found an area of your own
steps.hint: `acreate <prefix> <name>`. Own one already? `build claim` credits it to you.

steps.label: An area you can forage in
